params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly renames local variables from non-compliant snake_case (e.g., convex_hull) to compliant camelCase (e.g., convexHull) following the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the logic and structure of the code remain intact. The only exception is a commented-out line that was slightly modified to fix a syntax error (replacing `*convex_hull` with `convexHull`), which is related to the variable renaming and does not affect functionality.

Score: 3
